metadata.short_desc: Group flood detection with auto-mute; threshold, window, duration and notice text all configurable
metadata.desc: Counts messages within a time window (any message by default, or same-message-only mode) and mutes when the threshold is reached. Threshold, window, mute duration and the notice template can be set on the plugin config page, or overridden per group in QQ by group admins via the /flood command. Commands are English; docs and in-chat replies are Chinese.

same_message_only.description: Only count repeats of the same message
same_message_only.hint: On: trigger only when the same content repeats to the threshold. Off (default): any N messages in the window trigger

only_chat_messages.hint: When off, notice events (recall, admin changes, joins, poke, etc.) are counted too

max_messages.description: Message count that triggers a mute
max_messages.hint: Triggers when reached; counts same-message repeats when same_message_only is on, otherwise total messages in the window

text_normalize.description: Ignore case and whitespace when comparing text

mute_seconds.hint: 0 means count only, no real mute

notify.description: Send a notice in the group when triggered

manage_permission.description: Who may change this group's settings

manage_users.description: Extra user IDs allowed to manage this group

exempt_group_admins.hint: The bot usually cannot mute the group owner anyway

flood.description: Flood Guard: /flood status | mode | limit | window | mute | notice | reset
